body.label: enclosure
assumptions: long straight anomalies are masonry walls
walls meet at right angles and close into a circuit
a gap in a wall line is robbing or erosion, not a real opening
shorter lines inside the circuit are buildings
body.confidence_rule: surveys: mean posterior of the walls weighted by how much of each was seen (the enclosure pays 15% for closing a circuit; a field system pays for lines that run across it); excavation: a wall found where one was predicted raises the enclosure sharply and lowers the field reading to 40%

body.label: fields
assumptions: linear anomalies are field boundaries or lynchets
boundaries run one way across the slope; lines across them are unexplained
nothing is extended beyond what the surveys show
